title: Docusign Standard to self-hosted DocuSeal
summary: DocuSeal is lighter to run than Documenso and does the same job. The legal question is identical, though.

you_lose: Docusign on the audit trail, which is worth something in a dispute
Enterprise procurement acceptance you do not have to argue for
you_gain: A single Rails app that runs happily on a small box
No envelope limits at any team size
AGPL-3.0, with the signing implementation open to inspection

caveats: Everything on the Documenso page applies here: validity depends on your jurisdiction and on the evidence you can produce, and "cryptographically sound" is not the same as "accepted by the other side's lawyers".
DocuSeal needs materially less server than Documenso, which is most of why the arithmetic differs between the two pages.
For contracts worth more than the annual saving, we would stay on Docusign and treat the difference as insurance.
